h1: Mexico City travel, stays & events guide
heroText: Mexico City works best as a base in Mexico when you anchor days around Zocalo, National Museum of Anthropology Mexico and Chapultepec Park. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Mexico City International handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first Mexico City stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Mexico City hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use City centre for sightseeing, Old Town for a different local base, and Waterfront or Airport area when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Mexico City unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.

history.text: The latter arrived around the 14th century to settle first on the shores of the lake.
